llm_response.reason: The website returns a 404 error on the main advertised URL and provides no content or hyperlinks even on the root domain. There is no evidence of legitimate company information, contact methods, or privacy policy. SSL certificate issues and the use of privacy-protected, recently registered domain (2024) add further suspicion. These signs match the key characteristics of scam websites aiming to deceive users looking for diet supplements (Fake Online Shopping/Health Products).
